Hi all,

Thanks for the details — ON24 can accept SSO parameters and map them to custom registrant fields. Below is the minimal config we need on your redirect/registration link: 

- query param name: sso_provider (we can also accept sso=true)
- For SSO-linked users we recommend passing sso_provider=okta or sso_provider=azure so you can segment by provider in exports
- Custom field mapping: sso_linked -> boolean (true/false)

Recording consent: we recommend storing the checkbox as a required boolean field named sponsor_recording_consent. ON24 will include that in the export and it's available in the Download > Registrants CSV.

Technical snippet attached (on24_sso_params_snippet.txt) showing how to add parameters to the registration URL and an example export column mapping.

We can do a live test session on May 5th to exercise the SSO flow, registration, and export. Let me know a 60-minute window that works for you.

Best,
